name: Supplier Portal
description: Enterprise supplier-facing portal replacing manual email workflows with real-time communication between internal teams and suppliers. Integrated SAP services and third-party APIs to automate data exchange, with SignalR-based live notifications cutting repetitive back-and-forth messaging.

name: SSO Authentication Platform
description: Centralized Single Sign-On platform serving multiple internal applications with JWT-based authentication and role-based access control. Part of the broader monolith-to-microservices migration — decoupling authentication from legacy systems into a standalone service.

name: Issue Reporting System
description: Cross-platform issue reporting system built as a final year project. Mobile app (Expo), web dashboard (React), and a .NET Core backend — designed for end-to-end issue submission, tracking, and resolution workflows.

name: Easy Appy
description: Personal job application automation tool that connects to Gmail, attaches a CV, and sends templated application emails with just an email address and position name — built to solve a real repetitive task during my own job search.
